_about: Final and near-final pre-election demographic polling for the 2013 federal election, assembled from the lanes in .build/analysis/election-demographics (agent-scraped lane JSONs; every figure traceable to a verbatim source saved under src/). Shares are the houses' printed figures, re-based to decided voters where a printed undecided share existed (und kept on the wave). Non-standard keys besides alp/lnp/grn/onp/oth: pup, sample, trend2pp, nxt, kap, uap, note, ind, caution. See provenance for per-house sources; gaps record what was probed and not found. Fieldwork dates/samples are null where the surviving copies don't carry them.

notes: Essential: Essential never printed voting-intention crosstabs by gender/age/state in its weekly reports — checked the full text of all three final-week PDFs: no VI demographic tables exist. Dims are none for 2013/2019 and only the printed already-voted split for 2016. That split (22% of enrolled respondents said they had already voted) reads {Have/Have not} voted with per-cell 2PP as printed (L–NP shown: Have-voted 54–46, Have-not 49–51; alp2 recorded).

Essential: 2013 final wave column '5/9/13': Liberal National 43 / Labor 35 / Greens 10 / Other+Independent 12; 2PP 52–48 (2010 flows); don't-know excluded. The report's About page (sample, fieldwork dates, house panel) is not readable in the saved copies — the 2013-era subsetted fonts strip most of it in extraction — so sample and fieldwork window are null rather than transcribed from an unverifiable reading.

Essential: 2016 special pre-election poll conducted online 27–30 June 2016, n=1,212 (Your Source); printed to the nearest 0.5 point (components sum to 100.5); NXT printed as its own SA-only column, kept as 'nxt' beside the five standard keys (oth excludes NXT as printed). Publication 1 July 2016.

Essential: 2019 weekly omnibus 10–14 May 2019, n=1,201 (Qualtrics), published 14 May; components printed Liberal 36.2 / National 3.6 with the report's own combined line reading 38.5 (rounding); 2PP 51.5 Labor (2016 flows); Publication 14 May 2019.
Essential: 2022 not probed: Essential suspended its voting-intention question after the 2019 election and resumed only in late 2023 — there is no 2022 final-week Essential VI cross-tab to file.

Roy Morgan: PUP KEYING (2013): the lane brief asked PUP be treated as inside oth with onp:null. The source PRINTS Palmer United Party as its own column, separate from 'Ind./Other', so for verbatim fidelity PUP is filed as its own 'pup' key (same pattern as the 'uap'/'nxt' keys used here and by the Newspoll lane); merge pup+oth downstream if a 4-party schema is needed. onp:null — One Nation was not in the field in 2013 (its 2013-era vote was inside Ind./Other).

Roy Morgan: Every 2013 state/city/age row sums to exactly 100 with the five printed columns; national sum 100. 2016 wave sums 100 (ONP printed 'n/a' → null). 2019 wave sums 100. 2022 waves sum 100 (34+34+13+4+1+5+9). No row exceeded 100.5.

Roy Morgan: L-NP PARENTHETICAL in 2013/2016 tables: 'L-NP 44 (3)' prints a bracketed second figure. In 2016 Morgan's own table header context (NXT column era) and the era's Morgan conventions this is the National-party component; in the 2013 release its definition is not restated on the page — filed as 'lnpParen' information only via this note: NSW (5.5), VIC (2), QLD (0.5), WA (5), SA (1), national (3), CapCities (0.5), Country (7); 2016 May 21/22&28/29 wave: (3.5). Do not treat as a party share.

Roy Morgan: 2013 DUAL 2PP FORMS: each state's 2PP appears twice — the 'vs 2010 election' single table (filed as alp2/lnp2) and the 4-week trend table Sep 4-6 column (filed as trend2pp). Example NSW 48.5/51.5 vs 47/53. Both forms printed in the same release; no reconciliation attempted.

Roy Morgan: 2016 MORGAN GAP RESOLVED: handoff expected an SMS poll ~1 Jul 2016 (L-NP 50.5). Disproven by Morgan's own historical tables (last wave May 21/22 & 28/29, then the election), the ABIX release index (consumer-confidence posts but no federal VI release 25 Jun-4 Jul 2016), Poll Bludger's 1 Jul 2016 final-roundup (which lists 'final results from Newspoll, Galaxy, ReachTEL, Ipsos and Essential Research' — no Morgan), and Wikipedia's 2016 table. The 'L-NP 50.5' memory belongs to the final Newspoll (50.5-49.5 Coalition). Live roymorgan.com does not serve pre-2021 findings (5169 and 7980 slugs both 404 live — saved as src/morgan/2019-sms-7980-live-404.html); all legacy-release content here therefore comes via Wayback captures (IA was 'Temporarily Offline' most of the pass, recovered near the end and yielded 6831 + 7975).
